{{Top|leg}}
'''Yvellee Cha''' was a renowned [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] who was rumored to be a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a conflict between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], she announced her retirement, and an individual was sent to acquire her navigation charts.<ref name="Explorer's Legacy">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Explorer's Legacy}}</ref>
